label: Other-report
definition: A rating of the base construct provided by another informant

label: IAT
definition: A measurement of the base construct using an Implicit Association Test

label: Task
definition: A measurement of the base construct obtained from a behavioral or performance task

label: Self-rated performance
definition: Self-appraisal of performance in a specific task; for task-based constructs whose historical unsuffixed code denotes observer assessment. Distinct from ordinary global BESSI self-report.
